positive.description: Grounded retrieval from the workspace's onboarding content. Run first; changes nothing.
positive.prompt: What does the Welcome to brainattic guide in my workspace say I should do first?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the 'Welcome to brainattic' document in workspace chatgpt-test-rf2l, citing the supporting passage and the document. Makes no changes.

positive.description: Create workspace structure. Run after test 1.
positive.prompt: Create a project named Review Demo and a group named Onboarding, then list my projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the project Review Demo and the group Onboarding, then lists projects; the list includes Review Demo.

positive.description: Read the workspace rules before writing, then file a document. Run after test 2.
positive.prompt: Check this workspace's rules, then create a note titled Review demo note in Review Demo that says hello.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the applicable workspace rules first, then creates the document 'Review demo note' in project Review Demo and returns its title and link.

positive.description: Surgical edit with retained revisions. Run after test 3.
positive.prompt: In Review demo note, replace "hello" with "hello, edited", then show its revision history.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens an edit session, stages the replacement, commits exactly one new revision, and lists two retained revisions (original and edited).

positive.description: Reversible archive and restore. Run after test 4.
positive.prompt: Archive Review demo note, confirm it is gone from my document list, then restore it.
positive.expected_behavior: Archives the document, shows it absent from the active document list, then restores it. Nothing is deleted.

negative.description: Calendar request. brainattic holds no calendar data and should not be called.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have on my calendar tomorrow?

negative.description: Public web research. brainattic searches only the user's private workspace, not the web.
negative.prompt: Find today's top news about the EU AI Act on the web.
